environment: Linux / headless Chromium / real IPv4 UDP loopback and HTTP+WebSocket

checks.name: Authenticated recorded replay renders all ten matched source values and is labelled not live
Browser start -> UDP socket -> parsed data -> WebSocket -> clock and ten rows
Stopping UDP input suppresses the clock and shows stale state while retaining labelled test rows
Resumed UDP input recovers without restarting the listener
Client WebSocket watchdog suppresses its clock even while server UDP remains fresh
Operator stop closes reception and suppresses the current clock
UDP observation never publishes or changes official results
Updated dashboard has no JavaScript errors or Internet requests
Arabic guide renders RTL and fits a 390px mobile viewport
